evidence.title: Remix Icon - Open source icon library
GitHub - Remix-Design/RemixIcon: Open source neutral style icon system · GitHub

name: Remix Icon
summary: Open-source icon library of 3200+ neutral-style symbols, shipped as SVG, webfont, sprite and React/Vue packages.
description: An open-source icon library of 3200+ neutral-style symbols, each drawn in outlined and filled styles on a 24x24 grid. Icons are available as SVG and PNG downloads, a webfont, an SVG sprite and React/Vue packages, with an official Figma plugin, an MCP server and PowerPoint/Keynote versions. Free for personal and commercial use under the Remix Icon License v1.0.
contains: 3200+ icons in outlined and filled styles on a 24x24 grid
SVG and PNG downloads, SVG sprite and webfont (npm, CDN or manual)
official Figma plugin, plus MCP server and PowerPoint/Keynote versions
free for personal and commercial use, attribution optional
